notes: Branches by state are not published: the FY2025 10-K says only that, as of December 31, 2025, Schwab "had more than 380 domestic branch offices in 48 states and the District of Columbia, as well as locations in Puerto Rico, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and Singapore". Sites are the FY2025 10-K Item 2 table of significant locations at December 31, 2025 (square footage in thousands, net of subleased space). San Francisco, CA (417,000 sq ft leased in the FY2024 table) is no longer in the table and was removed; Richfield, OH (117,000 sq ft owned) takes the twelfth place, and El Paso, TX (105,000 sq ft owned) is left out for the 12-site cap. The three FDIC deposit metrics (June 30, 2024 Summary of Deposits) are kept as defined but carry no rows, so the June 30, 2026 release was not added. [Editor] The FDIC rows are omitted from the map: all three banks book deposits at a single Westlake, Texas office, so a state map would show where the charters sit, not where clients are.
